name: 33147 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33147 (Miami) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33147 (Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33147 (Miami) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 78% of all organizations here have no identified type.
